name: Introduction to Stochastic Modeling and Simulation
description: Quick review - basic probability, random variables; introduction to discrete time Markov chains - definition and characterization, transient distributions, limiting behavior, first passage times, applications/case studies; Poisson processes, continuous time Markov chains - introduction, transient and limiting behavior, applications/case studies; simulation - basics, discrete event simulation, concept of Markov decision process.
